reason: v1.25 §A. Thirteen example sentences transcribed their own headword with a reading the card does not teach, and exKana is the literal typing target the learner is graded against. Five are proven by byte-identical synthesised audio (instrument 1 of check_dictation_readings), which is proof of the phoneme sequence rather than an inference, and in every one of the five the voice takes the CARD's reading. Seven more were classified as a MEANING difference — the reading changes what the sentence says — independently by Codex and Gemini 3.7 Flash, with the English translation as a third, non-circular witness. One (n1-b039) is a recorded split. Eight further entries were classified REGISTER by both models and are deliberately NOT touched: v1.21 §C decided minority readings are not errors. Two further per-spelling corrections ride along: 箱 read ばこ in 18 standalone positions where the rendaku allomorph cannot occur, and 言う read ゆう, the reading v1.18 retired.

entries.to: はこからげーむきのほんたいをとりだした
entries.why: 箱 read ばこ -> はこ. 18 sentences read 箱 as ばこ and none as はこ, while the corpus's only 箱 card is n5-b144/はこ. ばこ is a rendaku allomorph that occurs only as the second half of a compound (本箱, ゴミ箱); every one of the 18 is standalone — three are sentence-initial, six follow この, the rest follow a particle or an adjective — so none of them can be ばこ.
